decision: Implement and synthetically qualify a new continuous whole-source summary helper and bounded eight-shard lookup probe before freezing any national execution recipe.

source.identityProvenance: Existing inventory/data-run records; not rehashed or decoded for this plan
source.capFailure: Count received rejected objects and the first cap+1 sentinel before stopping; undecoded objects remain unknown. No retry or partial-EOF claim.

implementation.abi: New gp_country_screen_abi/gp_country_screen_pbf/gp_country_screen_frames symbols, ABI version0x00010000. A separate library/bridge; no patching old globals, chunk resets or monkey-patching. Freeze exact structs/event tags and candidate artifact hash after compiled controls.
implementation.integers: uint64 checked object/type/byte/ref/member/row/call/checkpoint counters, source length and bounds; positive signed63 IDs; uint32 only bounded event/frame/4096-row lengths. Python int counters aggregate both passes including failures.
modes: summary: validate and GPF1-seal ALL objects, suppress ordinary Python node/way/relation dictionaries/JSON
full-field proof: bounded synthetic/saved-small records, compare all projected fields and semantic seal to frozen Python reference
events: 1MiB-or-final GPF1 semantic batches, each record length checked before copying
4096-row-or-final encoded node blocks plus source block/shard ordinals, IDs, row counts, max/byte/counter summaries
exact ambiguous node canonical fallback only, <=2MiB frame, counted <=65536/pass; unavailable/refusal stops
checkpoint every65536 received objects plus final, and error receipt with no success EOF
bounded typed source-witness rows and final bounded selected-way trace; no ordinary way/relation projections in summary mode
implementation.metadata: Retain all original source framing/features/granularity/snapshot/visibility/identity/version/order/duplicate/calendar/UTF8/tags/copy/ref/member/XY/exact canonical cap rules before selection. Node canonical fallback uses unchanged Python canonical sizing; no approximate rejection or float-format substitute.
implementation.checkpoints: Continuous pass state and strictly increasing typed IDs; final checkpoint/receipt only after native EOF and flush. Hard independent process watchdog covers framing, stalled native callbacks and posthash. Persist at most one progress log entry/60s, not one file/event.

reader.notAProof: These queue settings constrain concurrency; hard4GiB cgroup plus measured memory remain necessary.

sourceCodec.oracle: Frozen delta C ABI encoder/decoder, compare every decoded ID/XY directly to original native source arrays before dropping payloads. Independent Python ReferenceCodec checks synthetic/probe files separately.

pythonCodecBudgets.scope: Separate from source-object counts and C++ encode/roundtrip counters. Existing codec constructor supports explicit positive budgets, but no existing experiment is widened.

implementation.sourceByteBoundary: New file-length option and bridge accept only the bound12,229,320,016-byte national file for screen mode after preserved framing/prehash guards; synthetic mode uses explicitly smaller frozen bounds. No unchecked file-size widening in old wrappers.

counterCaps.rule: All cumulative adds checked before overflow/allocation; accepted-source caps distinct from failed received sentinel counters. Explicit source/metadata/witness/trace/event/log and storage caps apply in worker, not only host recipe.

compiler.scope: Same qualified projector build flags with new source/output names; no fast-math. Freeze exact build argv, exports/ABI, source/header/rootfs hashes and target ELF/load controls before use. Link frozen delta source unchanged; no source acquisition.

phases.scope: Future run only: verify frozen code/tool/header/image/control bindings; new exclusive owned output; fresh free-space/cgroup/capability/mount checks; source exact identity. No unrelated producers or asset-proof jobs concurrently. Record host load/cache as uncontrolled. Reject existing/used recipe/output. Host binding SHA reads source once within240s, separately counted; pass framing checks MD5/SHA again. No host source hash in current planning/qualification stages.

Full framing/decompression/pre-SHA+MD5/features/state, continuous full native validation/GPF1/normal EOF, exact block+shard+catalog byte census; write only selected mini-index shards and bounded trace/summary; full post-SHA/stable stat. All node/way/relation counts must match inventory.

Same whole-source guards and continuous validation; independently source-build the same mini-index/global summaries/way selection. Capture requested ID/XY witness directly from source node view. Authenticate and compare each corresponding original mini-shard before exact owned rolling removal; final source/semantic/counters/directories/catalogs/trace equality required.

Only after BOTH whole normal EOFs and all source/semantic/summary/probe/witness equality. Three fixed cohorts, cold-application/warm/repeat; independent source-witness bits/order/duplicates; full per-batch queried-shard checksums unchanged.

Independent pure Python/reference-codec probe decode/census formula/trace selection from bounded emitted candidates and receipts, source-witness/result comparison; logical and allocated peak+IO/time/cgroup metrics; exit/OOM/cleanup independent exact-ID absence; close manifest/decision without promoting a model. Reference audit reads each retained shard once and decodes bounded blocks; report its IO separately, not as lookup authenticated-shard IO.

allTypes: received/accepted/rejected counts, strict typed ID order/unique/maxID/version/timestamp/tag/canonical byte maxima
all-field GPF1 semantic digest; total semantic/canonical/copy/ref/member bytes, references/member type totals and maximum per-object sizes
per-type first/last times and checkpoint counters; fallback and Python raw-projection counts; normal EOF/count equality
allNodes: each lossless4096-row block, payload/header bytes and digest; every source shard seal and global directory/catalog
exact would-be full-index logical bytes including sidecars, namespace/file count and distribution, allocation formula applied separately
positive signed63 domain; measured maximum ID must never be substituted with a sample maximum or assumed2**40
census.memory: Keep one <=35,679,872-byte source shard to seal without storing a full national index; <=16MiB directory and <=4MiB catalog per pass. Source blocks roundtrip natively; Python handles bounded blocks/semantic batches, not per-object records.
census.comparison: Byte-for-byte passA/passB global directories/catalogs/block stream seals and mini manifests, counts/maxima/semantic/trace. Same implementation in both passes is a rebuild/drift check, not an independent national metadata oracle.
census.nationalStorageGate: After normal EOF compute exact full-index logical L. Conservatively use files=766 shards+3 sidecars, R=4096*files+8192*files+1MiB, I=ceil(1.5*(L+R)); require I<=24GiB. Require retainedReservations + I + ceil(1.5*(maximumShardBytes + globalDirectoryBytes + 4MiB + 3*4096))<=64GiB for the original future rolling two-pass index design. Screen output itself must separately stay<=1GiB and retained+screen<=64GiB. Report independent conservative maximum-ID varint bound from resource_arithmetic.py; passing neither proves physical national allocation nor admits extraction.
census.nationalTimeGate: Each protected source pass <=3000s and worker<=7200s. This measures this screen, including metadata/mixed/seal/roundtrip/sink costs; excludes full road selection/extraction/matcher and is not a full-import forecast.

probe.selectionFormula: floor(k*(766-1)/7), k=0..7; zero-based source-node ordinal shards of512 blocks*4096 rows. Fixed before results; no geographic inputs.
probe.sourceToMiniMapping: Preserve original complete block boundaries/IDs/XY/payload bytes. Renumber only mini shard/directory entries and dependent header/directory/catalog seals. Record original source ordinals and hashes beside each mini ordinal.
probe.integrity: Reuse frozen block-id-delta-xy32-v1 codec and V2 Reader: authenticate full immutable queried-shard snapshot every batch even on cache hit; first snapshot also full format validation; <=64 decoded cache blocks/4MiB. Old32MiB experiment index cap stays unchanged; this new recipe explicitly proposes384MiB aggregate index budget and64MiB file cap.
probe.replacement: Never remove original mini shard before corresponding passB shard is source-built, sealed, fully authenticated and equal; only exact owned path. Late failure closes as untrusted even if earlier mini shards were replaced. Preserve partial artifacts and all old failed indices.

wayTrace.eligibility: Every validated highway-tagged way with2..1024 references, all positive ref IDs within the numeric first..last ranges of the eight selected source shards. This range test does NOT prove membership; missing source witness is a hard dependency failure.
wayTrace.selection: Keep up to128 eligible ways with smallest (splitmix64(uint64(wayID) XOR seed),wayID,sourceWayOrdinal); bounded native heap. splitmix64 includes state increment and wraps modulo2**64, defined/tested in resource_arithmetic.py; seed0x47504c414e4e4552. No top-up, resampling or outcome selection.
wayTrace.counters: Count all highway ways, short/long/out-of-range exclusions, eligible ways, refs examined and selected occurrences; separate source metadata and numeric-range eligibility. Emit bounded selector audit: all candidate priority <= final cutoff (at most128), plus next-minimum excluded priority and totals; independent exact-selector controls remain essential. This compact audit cannot independently revalidate all national candidates.
wayTrace.witness: After passA freeze union of local/spread/road queries sorted/deduplicated (<=136146 IDs), capture ID64/XY32 directly from passB source into <=8MiB typed rows+presence bitmap; every requested ID exactly once. Compare binary64 division bits and original order/duplicates after lookup. Same helper source path is not a separate pyosmium national oracle.
wayTrace.failure: Fewer than64 eligible ways or missing witness: report insufficient/failure; never silently skip, replace choices or claim road-lookup coverage.

cohorts.queries: Reverse first1024 source IDs in first retained shard, then append their first128 in original order
First ID of EVERY block of the eight retained shards, round-robin by local block ordinal then selected shard ordinal; append first128
Selected ways sorted by priority tuple, refs in source order, preserve all duplicates; contiguous batches<=65536 IDs, at most2 batches/repeat

lookup.cacheReset: Clear decoded cache and format_verified once before each cohort only; retain through its three runs. No OS page-cache flush or OS-cold claim.
lookup.metrics: Record every cohort/run batch count, unique IDs/blocks/shards, cache hits/misses/evictions, authenticated-shard bytes/hash seconds, catalog/other bytes, decode calls/rows/seconds and total wall time. Measure rather than infer kernel physical IO. No per-latency threshold besides300s aggregate/4GiB shard IO.
lookup.scope: Source-ordinal stratification and actual range-eligible highway references only; excludes most road dependencies and is not a representative national routing/lookup or accuracy distribution.

resources.otherWorkerAllowanceIncludes: independent audits/catalogs/stats/resource sampling and bounded closures; no extra source scan
resources.measurement: Record memory.current/peak and memory.events/cgroup OOM, CPU/process IO, st_size/st_blocks live files plus namespace counts and Docker writable/tmp allocation. memory reservations and namespace reserves are proposals, not measured maxima. If required cgroup counters are unavailable, stop before source execution; no ru_maxrss substitute.
resources.hardStop: First source/guard/count/semantic/EOF/ABI/callback/resource/time/IO/trace/witness/equality failure stops; retain partial counters/checkpoint/errors but no successful EOF or promotion. No rerun or larger allowance to make results pass.
resources.capacity: Fresh host/Docker capacity includes preserved12.23GB source, old8.78GB failed index, runtime/tools/compiler closure and all prior outputs. Conservative existing reservations and new1GiB are arithmetic only; never delete old assets to pass. Fail if fresh available capacity/allocation accounting cannot establish the bound.
resources.compilerIsolation: Separate synthetic build/qualification stage only, using saved pinned rootfs/headers and cached runtime. Same4GiB/2CPU baseline; compiler alone narrowly SYS_CHROOT, cleared before scoped-env exec. No compiler capability or network in future screen worker.

qualificationBeforeFreeze: New C ABI layout/version/endian/size/null/buffer/checked-add failures; all type/count/source byte counters tested across2**31,2**32,near2**64 with small synthetic counter arithmetic controls, never billions of generated rows.

All existing metadata/canonical cap/fallback/ref/member/XY/framing/state/source drift/EOF/callback lifetime/reentry/cap+1/reference-rejection regressions, run in actual target Linux with zero native skips; full-field/GPF1 exact agreement to frozen Python reference.

Summary mode over multi-type synthetic PBF matches full-field results, records zero ordinary Python node/way/relation projections, validates discarded invalid metadata; every emitted encoded node block roundtrips original arrays.

Reduced fixed block/shard fixtures exercise8-stratum formula, nonadjacent original ordinals, partial final block/shard, exact census vs fully written reference index, mini remap, sorted-ID gaps, independent source witness and all selector vectors/ties/eligibility/exclusions.

Independent Python ReferenceCodec decodes probe blocks; source-built witness vs index lookup with duplicates/order/missing ID, >64-block eviction and cold/warm/repeat accounting; no weakened full-shard check. Same-size/same-mtime shard/catalog drift still rejects.

Rolling comparison/removal exact ownership, late passB failure leaves untrusted files; cap-1/cap/cap+1 for all buffers/indices/directory/working/file/trace/IO/fallback limits, bounded malformed events and unavailable metrics.

Hard watchdog interrupts stuck native/no callbacks/framing/posthash, correct rejected/partial counters and error EOF, worker OOM/nonzero/client errors, refuse unrelated cleanup, independently verify exact owned removal/absence.

Freeze exact candidate sources/tests/runner/artifact/tool/header/image/control results and resource plan only after checks pass; synthetic corpus aggregate<=2million source receipts,64MiB files,1GiB work+tmp,300s qualification worker/600s host. Declare exhaustive test list/expected counts in qualification recipe before running; no national source mount in qualification.

futureOutputContract.success: Both complete protected passes/source identities/counts/order/metadata/GPF1/census/probe/trace/witness equality; >=64 eligible ways; all fixed lookup bits and integrity/resource/time/lifecycle gates. Report measured facts and separate conditional24GiB/64GiB index screen outcome; storage-screen failure remains a failure even when scan completes.
